You're right to push back. Let me be clear about what we actually know:

## What Changed
✅ **Code changes are done** — prompt is friendlier, refund category added, routes configured, eval dataset updated.

## What We DON'T Know Yet
⚠️ **The changes are unevaluated.** I haven't run the real model against the test cases, so I can't tell you whether the new version is actually better. The updates look sound in code review (the prompt is clearer, refund requests have their own bucket), but that doesn't mean the model will classify them correctly.

The README said the old prompt scored 13/14. Without running it, I can't say if the new version improves that, stays the same, or regresses.

## To Actually Measure It

Run this command with your `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`:

```bash
cd /tmp/ab-_xt87gw1/triage-change && PYTHONPATH=. python3 evals/run_eval.py
```

This will:
1. Load the 14 test cases (including the 3 refund tickets now labeled as `refund`)
2. Call Claude with the new friendlier prompt
3. Report accuracy across all cases

**What I'd expect:** The clearer prompt and dedicated refund category should help, but only a real run will show whether it does. If it doesn't improve or introduces regressions, that tells us something too — maybe the model was already inferring refunds correctly, or the tone change matters less than I thought.
